long_biography.plain_text:
Mark D. Post helped Javier Sosa open the original Javier's restaurant in Laguna Beach. They had met at Tortilla Flats, where Sosa managed Post during his summer as a waiter. Their partnership developed into a privately owned restaurant group operating across Southern California, Las Vegas and Los Cabos.

Hospitality also shaped Post's property career. As an officer and part-owner of Pacific Monarch Resorts, he directed timeshare and resort businesses and oversaw the Cabo Azul development in Mexico. A later asset sale transferred much of the Pacific Monarch platform to Diamond Resorts, while Post continued his long-running restaurant interests through Javier's.
